translations.ui.d398ae18ddb4: Ọ na-emepụta oge n'akụkụ sava; a naghị ekwu na oku PSTN dị ọ gwụla ma onye na-eweta telecom eziga ihe omume na webhook echekwara.

translations.ui.8ef964729e07: Ọ na-ewere oku kacha ochie n'ahịrị ma kenye onye nnọchiteanya kacha mma dị (njikọ nka, mgbe ahụ nchere kacha ogologo). Naanị mkpebi nkenye — ọ bụghị njikọ ekwentị n'ezie.
translations.ui.43db61570404: Maapụ na-eji Leaflet na data ndụ /v1/gis/fleet. UI anaghị emepụta isi ụgbọala.
translations.ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Igwefoto na ihe nchọgharị na-ejide ihe akaebe n'obodo. Ntụziaka na-abịa site na GPS, mgbe ahụ enwere ike izipu ihe akaebe na sava site na tiketi enyere ikike.
translations.ui.06fa943be019: Nhazi bụ nke a kpebiri: ngwa ngwa SLA + njikọ nka + anya + ibu ọrụ. Sava bụ ikike maka nkenye.
translations.ui.f1a80e3e8395: Nke a abụghị ihuenyo ịchọ mma. Ndepụta dị n'okpuru bụ nke e wuru site na ntụaka HTML ejikọtara ma na-ekewa ikike ọ bụla dabere na ihe akaebe mmejuputa n'ime ebe nchekwa. Aha njirimara apụtaghị na njirimara zuru ezu.
translations.ui.1e22c22f5622: Ịgụ akụkọ ego naanị site na PostgreSQL. Enweghị AI CEO nọọrọ onwe ya, enweghị mmejuputa ego nọọrọ onwe ya, na enweghị nsonaazụ adịgboroja egosiri dịka eziokwu.
